steps.label: Key-value (Redis)
steps.sub: lookup by one known key — cache, sessions, flags

code:
Key-value:
  GET user:4821  ->  opaque blob
  no visibility into the value

Document:
  find({ status: "active", age: { $gt: 30 } })
  MongoDB reads and indexes the fields
caption: A document store can query what it stores. A key-value store can't.

code:
Relational:
  JOIN friends ON ... JOIN friends ON ...
  gets expensive, fast

Graph (Neo4j / Cypher):
  (person)-[:FRIEND]->()-[:FRIEND]->(fof)
  a fast, local traversal, not a JOIN chain
caption: This course covers three of the four: document, multi-model, and graph.
